comment: Regression policy for the weekly quality benchmark. A run fails only on a move away from the previously recorded run of the SAME dataset, never on an absolute value: real-data results shift with the scene, the season and the publisher's own processing, so an absolute gate would go red for reasons no commit caused. Fraction-valued and dimensionless-ratio metrics are gated by 'relative' x the previous value; everything else by its 'absolute' entry. A metric with a zero or absent tolerance is reported and never fails a run, and an unmeasured (null) metric never enters the gate. The DEM spread is gated on the offset-REMOVED p68/p95/NMAD: the raw median is the vertical datum difference between the two products, not something a commit can move.
